desc.zh: Ascend 图编译配置（typed 为 AscendCompilationConfig）。子键：enable_npugraph_ex（默认 true）、enable_static_kernel（默认 false，静态形状场景按 batch_size 预编译算子）、enable_super_kernel（v0.30.0 新增，缺省时跟随 enable_static_kernel）、fuse_norm_quant / fuse_qknorm_rope / fuse_muls_add（v0.30.0 新增，默认均 true）；v0.23.0 另有 fuse_allreduce_rms。依赖链 super_kernel → static_kernel → npugraph_ex，硬件不支持时自动降级。
desc.en: Ascend graph-compilation config (typed as AscendCompilationConfig). Sub-keys: enable_npugraph_ex (default true), enable_static_kernel (default false, pre-compiles per-batch-size operator binaries for static shapes), enable_super_kernel (new in v0.30.0, inherits enable_static_kernel when omitted), fuse_norm_quant / fuse_qknorm_rope / fuse_muls_add (new in v0.30.0, all default true); v0.23.0 also has fuse_allreduce_rms. Dependency chain super_kernel -> static_kernel -> npugraph_ex with auto-downgrade on unsupported hardware.

version_note.zh: enable_super_kernel / fuse_muls_add 自 v0.30.0 起；fuse_allreduce_rms 仅 v0.23.0 有
version_note.en: enable_super_kernel / fuse_muls_add since v0.30.0; fuse_allreduce_rms exists only on v0.23.0

note.zh: 官方 PD 教程两侧都配但配方不同：P 侧常以 --enforce-eager 跑 eager（如 Qwen3.5-397B 显式 enable_npugraph_ex: false），D 侧典型开 enable_npugraph_ex——DeepSeek-V4-Flash 原文「enables the extended NPU graph mode on Decode … Prefill runs in eager mode」；static/super kernel 在 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 等配方中仅 D 侧开启。
note.en: Official PD tutorials configure both sides differently: Prefill often runs eager (--enforce-eager; Qwen3.5-397B sets enable_npugraph_ex: false) while Decode enables enable_npugraph_ex (DeepSeek-V4-Flash: "enables the extended NPU graph mode on Decode ... Prefill runs in eager mode"); static/super kernel appear only on the D side in recipes like Qwen3.8-Flash-Next.

desc.zh: 融合算子配置。子键 fusion_ops_gmmswigluquant（默认 true）控制是否使用 GmmSwigluQuant 融合算子。pydantic 校验会拒绝未知子键。
desc.en: Fused-operator config. Sub-key fusion_ops_gmmswigluquant (default true) controls the GmmSwigluQuant fused operator. Pydantic validation rejects unknown sub-keys.

desc.zh: 投机解码的草稿 KV 滑窗：仅将草稿模型注意力限制在最近 N 个 token，目标模型仍用全上下文，输出质量不变。适配 eagle3/dflash/dspark 方法；长上下文运行时超出草稿训练长度导致接受率崩塌的场景使用。
desc.en: Draft KV sliding window for speculative decoding: caps only the draft model's attention to the most recent N tokens while the target model keeps full context, leaving output quality unchanged. Works with eagle3/dflash/dspark; for long contexts where the draft's acceptance collapses beyond its trained length.

note.en: Official DyntraLB guide: PD-disaggregated Decode nodes only (kv_role="kv_consumer"), DP>1, DP ranks on one node; "Do not add dyntra_lb_config with enabled=true to Prefill nodes"; incompatible with enable_balance_scheduling / profiling_chunk_config (startup rejection).

desc.zh: FlashComm2 并行规模，0 表示禁用。

note.en: GLM5 tuning table: "A3 prefill nodes"; DeepSeek-V4-Flash disables it on Prefill in favor of multistream_overlap_shared_expert; GLM5.2 sets 2 (MegaMoE) on the D side. Both sides configurable; value follows the model path.

desc.zh: 启用 KVPP（KV 流水线并行），把 MLA/SFA 非混合模型在 TP 各 rank 间冗余的 KV cache 按层分摊，同等显存容纳更多上下文 token 或并发请求。Experimental；仅支持 eager 或 PIECEWISE 图模式；PD 分离时只能在 prefill 节点开启。
desc.en: Enable KVPP (KV pipeline parallelism), distributing otherwise-replicated KV caches across TP ranks by layer for non-hybrid MLA/SFA models, so the same HBM fits more context tokens or concurrent requests. Experimental; eager or PIECEWISE graph mode only; for P/D disaggregation enable on the prefill node only.

note.zh: KVPP 官方指南：「Enable KVPP only on the prefill node」；PD 分离经 MooncakeConnectorV2（实验性），D-only 节点由源码校验强制禁用。
note.en: Official KVPP guide: "Enable KVPP only on the prefill node"; P/D via MooncakeConnectorV2 (experimental); hard-disabled on decode-only nodes by source validation.

desc.zh: 启用 Matmul 与 AllReduce 融合优化。

note.en: No colocated/PD guidance; known: RoCE inter-node dispatch/combine communication, to be replaced by mc2_comm_alg="hierarchy".

desc.zh: 启用 MLAPO（模型逐层自适应并行优化）。
desc.en: Enable MLAPO (Model Layer-wise Adaptive Parallel Optimization).

note.zh: Kimi-K2.6 与 GLM5 教程原文：「in PD scenarios enable MLAPO only on decode nodes」；混部高吞吐场景可用（GLM5 表「A3 co-located high-throughput / PD decode nodes」）；注意消耗更多 NPU 显存。
note.en: Kimi-K2.6 and GLM5 tutorials: "in PD scenarios enable MLAPO only on decode nodes"; usable for co-located high-throughput (GLM5 table); consumes more NPU memory.

desc.zh: PCP size > 1 时，在每个 TP 分片内对 embedding 与 LM Head 权重跨 PCP rank 分片。与 batch-sharded sampling 及这两个模块的细粒度 TP 不兼容。
desc.en: When PCP size > 1, shard embedding and LM Head weights across PCP ranks within each TP shard. Incompatible with batch-sharded sampling and fine-grained TP for these modules.

desc.en: Whether PCP shards O-projection weights inside the group (SFA-PCP o_proj and DSA-PCP two-stage wo_a/wo_b). Auto-disabled with a warning when unsupported; unused by other attention backends.

desc.en: Reserve mc2_token_capacity for prefill batches using max_num_batched_tokens. Temporary switch; will be removed once MC2 is complete.

note.zh: 语义即「为 prefill batch 预留 mc2_token_capacity」；Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 配方 P 节点开启、D 节点不配。官方注明是临时开关，MC2 算子补全后移除。

desc.zh: 在 TP rank 间复制共享专家权重并以数据并行运行。提升性能但消耗更多内存，与上游 MoE 序列并行相互独立。
desc.en: Replicate shared-expert weights across TP ranks and run them data-parallel. Improves performance at higher memory cost; independent of upstream MoE sequence parallelism.

note.zh: 官方 PD 配方 P/D 两侧均出现；DeepSeek-V4-Pro 说明其作用为把 shared experts 放到 DP ranks。
note.en: Appears on both sides in official PD recipes; DeepSeek-V4-Pro: places shared experts on DP ranks.

desc.en: Config for offloading sparse KV cache to DRAM. Sub-keys: enabled, topk_buffer_size (-1 resolves to (1+num_speculative_tokens)*2048), dram_size_per_dp_GB (110), keep_device_kv_cache, use_fused_overlap. 950-series products (A5) only; do not set on prefill nodes.

note.zh: 官方分层/稀疏 KV 卸载指南：「Do not set sparse_kv_offload_config on Prefill」；D 节点用独立 host pool，配置与 P 侧不同；与 PreemptOffloadConnector 互斥（含 MultiConnector 包装）。
note.en: Official layerwise/sparse KV offloading guide: "Do not set sparse_kv_offload_config on Prefill"; Decode uses a separate host pool with different config; mutually exclusive with PreemptOffloadConnector (incl. inside MultiConnector).

desc.zh: Xlite 图模式配置。
desc.en: Configuration for Xlite graph mode.

note.zh: 官方 graph_mode 指南：默认（full_mode=false）token 预算按 decode 步 sizing，prefill 与大批次回退 ACLGraph——偏 D 侧重 decode；full_mode=true 时预算按 max_num_batched_tokens，prefill/decode 都走 xlite（建议 --enforce-eager）。
note.en: Official graph_mode guide: by default (full_mode=false) the token budget is sized for decode steps with prefill/large batches falling back to ACLGraph — decode-leaning; full_mode=true sizes by max_num_batched_tokens so prefill and decode both run on xlite (--enforce-eager recommended).
